NOTE: this pilot card is dated 2026-11-06; the decklist is dated 2026-11-12 and wins wherever they disagree. Cards it names that are not in the decklist have been cut; ignore advice built on them.
Pilot card · Temur · Bracket 3 · 11-06 list
 Flubs, the Fool
 Empty the hand, ping everyone, blow up the table.
 FLUBS, THE FOOL · Frog Scout G U R 
 You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
 Whenever you play a land or cast a spell , draw a card if you have no cards in hand . Otherwise, discard a card .
 Checked on resolution: casting your last card draws. Mandatory: no declining.
 0/5 
 Your turn, every turn

 Dump lands
 Scout, PuPu UFO : no Flubs trigger, still landfall.

 Two land drops
 Each = a Flubs draw. Sabotender, Valakut ping.
 4
 Cast it all
 Lands first, then cast in combat (beginning of combat counts): Zuko XP each.

 Armor up
 After a recast: Plate, then Greaves . Then attack: combat is where it goes off.
 Before the game
 Mulligan
 Flubs turn 3. Mulligan hard.
 Draw 7. Keep: 3–4 lands with two colors, or 2 lands + a cheap mana piece (Sol Ring, Mox, Fellwar, Cobra, Herbalist, STE, Scout, UFO, Rampant Growth, Lore). Ship: 0–1 lands; 2 lands, no ramp; 5+ lands, no action; two 5+ drops (Omnath, Etali, Slash, Split, Locust God) with no ramp.
 Say it
 "Seventeen printed stand-ins, ask what anything does." Call Flubs triggers out loud.

profile.engineTitle: Flubs is out. Run the engine.
engine: 1. Empty your hand of dead cards first: Wild Mongrel and Ravenous Bloodseeker discard for free.
2. Landfall payoffs before lands (Avenger, Retreat to Kazandu, Khalni Heart, Druid Class), so every land counts.
3. Play both lands: each one is a Flubs trigger and a landfall trigger.
4. Copies (Spark Double, Progenitor Mimic, Phantasmal Image) go on the creature doing the most work.
5. Before Thassa's Oracle, count your library against your devotion to blue.

tips.t: Cast Mox Diamond before Flubs. It needs a land to discard.
Flubs is out: Mox needs a land plus another card in hand, or Flubs makes you discard the land first.
You are holding an instant. Your next land makes you discard. Cast it first, or skip the land on purpose.
Zuko: every spell cast during combat is an experience counter. Beginning of combat counts, and so do opponents' combats.
Electro: unspent red mana stays. Combat red pays for main phase 2.
Leyline: cast the whole hand in combat for Zuko.
Tectonic Split: tap your lands for mana first, then sacrifice.
Cobra: every land adds a mana right away. Play lands before you cast.
Abundance: name land while you have drops left, nonland after.
Oracle: cast it while cards remain in your library.
Multiplier out: count pings per opponent before you swing.

profile.strategy:
Flubs, the Fool is a Temur (G/U/R) Commander deck, real cardboard. Flubs: you may play an additional land each turn; whenever you play a land or cast a spell, draw a card if your hand is empty, otherwise discard a card (checked on resolution).
Current direction (chosen 2026-11-12, replacing the old pinger / Fated Firepower plan): a hybrid. A landfall shell builds board and mana (Avenger of Zendikar, Field of the Dead, Khalni Heart Expedition, Retreat to Kazandu, Druid Class, Springheart Nantuko, Tireless Tracker, Lotus Cobra, Tireless Provisioner, Scute Swarm, Mina and Denn), Abundance and Eruth dig, and creature copies (Progenitor Mimic, Spark Double, Phantasmal Image, Strionic Resonator) multiply the key engine pieces. Finish: Omniscience plus Thassa's Oracle, or combat. The owner is not yet sure which of the two actually closes games and is recording it, so name which one a line relies on.
Keep Flubs alive (Lightning Greaves, Darksteel Plate, Spore Frog). Free discard outlets: Wild Mongrel, Ravenous Bloodseeker. Tables run 3 to 7 players. Pod house rule: no commander damage.
